description: This donut chart visually represents the categorization of characters into two primary groups: “Virtual Characters” and “Real Characters,” with the latter further subdivided. The central, largest blue ring is labeled “Virtual Characters” and is divided into six distinct segments: “Comic Characters,” “Movie Characters,” “Teleplay Characters,” “Novel Characters,” “Game Characters,” and “Characters” (which appears to be a placeholder or mislabeled segment). Surrounding this central ring is a smaller, green outer ring labeled “Real Characters,” which is further broken down into seven categories: “Scientists,” “Artists,” “Athletes,” “Writers,” “Musicians,” “Actors,” and “Influencers.” The chart includes a legend that maps the colors to these categories, with the “Virtual Characters” group shown in light blue and the “Real Characters” group in green. The “Characters” segment within the virtual group is visually distinguished by a gray overlay, and the “Real Characters” segment is slightly offset or exploded from the center, drawing attention to it. The chart does not include percentage labels within the slices, and the segments appear to be arranged in a roughly descending order of size, though the exact proportions are not quantified.
